subject.title: feat: add signed marketplace feed config

question: Should OpenClaw merge this signed marketplace feed config as a staged fail-closed contract before signed refresh enforcement lands?
rationale: This adds public trust-anchor config and a selected-profile runtime failure mode before the consumer exists; automation cannot choose that security and compatibility tradeoff for maintainers.

options.title: Require proof, then accept staged config
options.body: Require current-head redacted terminal/live proof first, then merge the staged config if maintainers still accept the temporary selected-profile failure mode.

options.title: Merge only with enforcement
options.body: Hold this PR until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98338 or equivalent signed refresh enforcement lands with it.

options.title: Reject staged config
options.body: Keep `mode: "signed"` schema-invalid until refresh and snapshot trust enforcement are present in the same landing set.

recommendation.title: Require proof, then accept staged config
recommendation.body: Require current-head redacted terminal/live proof first, then merge the staged config if maintainers still accept the temporary selected-profile failure mode.
